scripts.release: bun run build -- --public-path=/bmog/ && test -f dist/index.html && git -C /tmp/bmog-pages rm -rf . && cp -R dist/. /tmp/bmog-pages/ && touch /tmp/bmog-pages/.nojekyll && git -C /tmp/bmog-pages add -A && (git -C /tmp/bmog-pages diff --cached --quiet || (git -C /tmp/bmog-pages commit -m "Deploy site" && git -C /tmp/bmog-pages push))
